name: financify
description: Full-stack MERN personal finance management application

scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.serve: npm run build && cross-env SERVE_CLIENT=true npm run start:server
scripts.heroku-postbuild: cd client && npm install && npm run build
